=== nginx with X-Original-URL
> GET {{public}}/auth
> X-Original-Url: {{public}}/a?b=1
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< Cache-Control: no-store
< Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'sha256-EfDB+E4ozGZyNnGeFWw8YAFIRzU40oZ2Hx4vap8d8mI='; form-action 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
< Content-Type: application/json
< Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
< Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
< Www-Authenticate: Cookie realm="wicket"
< X-Auth-Redirect: {{public}}/login?app=whoami&rd={{public}}%2Fa%3Fb%3D1
< X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
< X-Frame-Options: DENY
< X-Request-Id: golden-1
<
{"error":{"code":"unauthenticated","message":"sign in at the URL in the X-Auth-Redirect header","request_id":"golden-1"}}

=== Traefik redirect mode: browser navigation
> GET {{public}}/auth?redirect=1
> Accept: text/html
> X-Forwarded-Host: {{host}}
> X-Forwarded-Method: GET
> X-Forwarded-Uri: /x
< HTTP/1.1 302 Found
< Cache-Control: no-store
< Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'sha256-EfDB+E4ozGZyNnGeFWw8YAFIRzU40oZ2Hx4vap8d8mI='; form-action 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
< Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
< Location: {{public}}/login?app=whoami&rd={{public}}%2Fx
< Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
< Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
< X-Auth-Redirect: {{public}}/login?app=whoami&rd={{public}}%2Fx
< X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
< X-Frame-Options: DENY
< X-Request-Id: golden-2
<
<a href="{{public}}/login?app=whoami&amp;rd={{public}}%2Fx">Found</a>.
